tweet.text:
Imagine there’s an ice cream truck outside. The ice cream man has had a stroke and passed out at the wheel, so I tell all the kids, “Hey, free ice cream!” So they can come steal from an obviously helpless man.

Now imagine there’s an ice cream truck outside. The ice cream man is handing out free scoops to everyone, so I tell all the kids, “Hey, free ice cream!” So they can come get ice cream from the dude willingly giving it away.

The contextual evidence in this case suggests “Free p***y” meant there was a chick knowingly handing out the goods, not an encouragement to steal. Which is why nothing explicitly criminal can be deduced from the text alone.
